# ChatGPT Math Delimiter Stress Test

Standard inline LaTeX parenthesis delimiter: \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}\) inside prose.

Display bracket delimiter:
\[\mathcal{L}\{f(t)\} = F(s) = \int_0^\infty f(t) e^{-st} \, dt\]

Double-escaped ChatGPT copy-paste inline: \\(\alpha + \beta = \gamma\\) and display:
\\[\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}\\]

Mixed dollar and bracket delimiters on the same line: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$ vs \(x_{1,2} = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\).
